attribution: Driving rules are curated content published under every source family of the rules domain the key is entitled to, and each answer is attributed to all of them. Every answer lists each such family in meta.attribution: its publisher, licence, licence URL and the attribution text a client must show wherever it displays the data, with meta.notes carrying any condition or purpose the licence attaches, verbatim. Families withheld by the key's licence terms are named in meta.warnings, never silently dropped.
